# conative_azuresql_database_role_member (Resource)

Makes a database user a member of one fixed database role, for example `db_owner`. The resource adds and removes exactly that one membership; the user and its other memberships are never touched.

Only the fixed database roles are supported. Creating the resource fails if the user is already a member; import the membership instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Make a database user the owner of the database, for example an identity that
# runs schema migrations.
resource "conative_azuresql_database_role_member" "orders_app_owner" {
  database = "orders"
  role     = "db_owner"
  member   = conative_azuresql_database_user.orders_app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database name. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `member` (String) Name of the database user. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `role` (String) A fixed database role: db_accessadmin, db_backupoperator, db_datareader, db_datawriter, db_ddladmin, db_denydatareader, db_denydatawriter, db_owner, db_securityadmin. Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The import ID, `database/role/member`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is database/role/member.
terraform import conative_azuresql_database_role_member.orders_app_owner orders/db_owner/orders-app
```
